records.text: He bottled it at the last minute and threw his colleagues under the bus.

artifact.comprehensible: At the very last moment, he lost his nerve and, to save himself, betrayed his colleagues by shifting the blame onto them.

glosses.gloss: lost his nerve at the crucial moment and failed to do what was needed

glosses.expression: threw his colleagues under the bus
glosses.gloss: sacrificed his colleagues to protect himself, letting them take the blame

artifact.translation: 他在最后一刻临阵退缩，还把自己的同事推出去当替罪羊。

records.text: The house stood in a state of genteel decay, its occupants having long since repaired to the Continent.

artifact.comprehensible: The house was in a state of dignified but shabby decline, because the people who lived there had moved away to mainland Europe a long time ago.

glosses.gloss: a kind of decline that still keeps a respectable, upper-class appearance
went to; moved to (a formal or old-fashioned use)
mainland Europe (especially from a British point of view)

artifact.grammar: The phrase 'its occupants having long since repaired to the Continent' is an absolute construction: it has its own subject ('its occupants') and a participle ('having repaired'), and it gives the reason or accompanying circumstance for the main clause. It is not a separate sentence, and 'having long since' means the moving away happened well before the time being described.
artifact.translation: 这栋房子处于一种体面而衰败的状态，因为它的住户早已迁往欧洲大陆。

records.text: The lessee shall indemnify the lessor against all claims arising from any breach of the covenants herein.

artifact.comprehensible: The person renting the property must protect the owner from any claims that come from breaking any of the promises made in this agreement.

glosses.gloss: to protect someone from loss or damage by paying for it or taking legal responsibility
the person who owns and rents out property
formal promises or agreements, especially in a contract

artifact.translation: 承租人应就因违反本协议中的任何约定而引起的所有索赔，向出租人作出赔偿。

records.text: It behoves us to consider whether such a course of action is consonant with our obligations.

artifact.comprehensible: It is proper for us to think about whether acting in that way fits with what we are obliged to do.

glosses.gloss: it is right or proper for us (to do something)

artifact.grammar: The sentence uses a formal, impersonal construction: 'It behoves us to consider...' means 'It is proper for us to consider...'. The 'whether' clause is the object of 'consider', and 'consonant with our obligations' is an adjective phrase describing 'such a course of action'.
artifact.translation: 我们应当考虑，这样的做法是否符合我们的义务。
